import java.util.*;

public class MinCostMaxFlowJava {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev;
        long flow, capacity;
        long cost;

        public Edge(int to, int rev, long flow, long capacity, long cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        int totalNodes;
        long INF = (long) 1e9;
        long[] dist, potential, flowCurr;
        int[] prevEdgeIdx, prevNodeIdx;
        PriorityQueue<long[]> pq;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;

        public MinCostMaxFlow(int n) {
            totalNodes = n;
            dist = new long[n];
            potential = new long[n];
            flowCurr = new long[n];
            prevEdgeIdx = new int[n];
            prevNodeIdx = new int[n];
            pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        public void addEdge(int s, int t, long cap, long cst) {
            adj.get(s).add(new Edge(t, adj.get(t).size(), 0, cap, cst));
            adj.get(t).add(new Edge(s, adj.get(s).size() - 1, 0, 0, -cst));
        }

        public long[] maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long totalFlow = 0;
            long totalCost = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
                dist[s] = 0;
                flowCurr[s] = INF;
                pq.clear();
                pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] curr = pq.poll();
                    long d = curr[0];
                    int u = (int) curr[1];
                    if (d != dist[u]) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
                        int v = e.to;
                        if (e.capacity <= e.flow) continue;
                        long newDist = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[v];
                        if (dist[v] > newDist) {
                            dist[v] = newDist;
                            pq.offer(new long[]{newDist, v});
                            prevNodeIdx[v] = u;
                            prevEdgeIdx[v] = i;
                            flowCurr[v] = Math.min(flowCurr[u], e.capacity - e.flow);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dist[t] == INF) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < totalNodes; i++) {
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
                }
                long delta = Math.min(flowCurr[t], Long.MAX_VALUE - totalFlow);
                totalFlow += delta;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevNodeIdx[v]) {
                    Edge e = adj.get(prevNodeIdx[v]).get(prevEdgeIdx[v]);
                    e.flow += delta;
                    adj.get(v).get(e.rev).flow -= delta;
                    totalCost += delta * e.cost;
                }
            }
            return new long[]{totalFlow, totalCost};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T = 500;
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int N = n * T;
        MinCostMaxFlow mcmf = new MinCostMaxFlow(N + 2);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; j++) {
                mcmf.addEdge(i * T + j, i * T + j + 1, Long.MAX_VALUE, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            mcmf.addEdge(i, N + 1, Long.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            mcmf.addEdge(N, x * T, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; j++) {
                int current = 1;
                for (int _ = 0; _ < k; _++) {
                    mcmf.addEdge(x * T + j, y * T + j + 1, 1, current * d + c);
                    mcmf.addEdge(y * T + j, x * T + j + 1, 1, current * d + c);
                    current += 2;
                }
            }
        }

        long[] flowResult = mcmf.maxFlow(N, N + 1);
        long totalFlow = flowResult[0];
        long totalCost = flowResult[1];

        // The original code asserts total_flow == k, but Java doesn't have assert enabled by default
        if (totalFlow != k) {
            System.err.println("Flow does not match expected k");
        }
        System.out.println(totalCost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
